column2: PART  IV(A) – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 05.12.2019
Wastewater and sewage shall be directed to a septic pit, suction pit, or central treatment unit by an approved
system of sealed drainage or other suitable construction material so that the waste does not rely on the required
slope.  Also,  a  water  trap  or an approved  suitable  method  should  be  used  to  prevent  combustion  between  the
premises and the final disposal.
When intending to operate a grocery store in an area not covered by the Solid Waste Management Service of
the pradeshiya Sabha, the license holder shall establish a formal waste disposal system to the satisfaction of the
Chairman  of  the  pradeshiya  Sabha according to  the reports of  the  Public  Health  Inspector  or  Health  Medical
Officer.

Notwithstanding  the  procedure  laid  down  under  this  By-Law,  adequate  measures  must  be  taken  to  prevent
wastewater and sewage from flowing into any public waterway, sewer or open land.
